events.label: military use
events.text: Moor at Ljungby adopted for military use by the Scanian Hussar Regiment as a training ground

evidence.quote: The moor at Ljungby was adopted for military use in 1658 by the Scanian Hussar Regiment as a training ground

events.label: first flights
events.text: First flights commenced from the grounds

evidence.quote: In 1910 , the first flights were commenced from the grounds

events.label: founding
events.text: Enoch Thulin sets up a public flying school, precursor of the school.

evidence.quote: Enoch Thulin set up a public flying school on June 16 , 1915

events.label: founding
events.text: Newly formed Swedish Air Force sets up its flying school at Ljungbyhed.

evidence.quote: In 1926 , the newly formed Swedish Air Force set up their flying school at Ljungbyhed

events.text: Arvid Flory becomes commanding officer (skolchef).
Arvid Flory leaves the post of commanding officer.
Åge Lundström becomes commanding officer.

events.label: colour
events.text: First school colour presented at F 8 Barkarby by King Gustaf V.

evidence.quote: The units first colour was presented at F 8 at Barkarby on 6 June 1939

events.text: Åge Lundström leaves the post of commanding officer.
Ingemar Nygren becomes commanding officer.
Ingemar Nygren leaves the post of commanding officer.
Knut Lindahl becomes commanding officer.
Knut Lindahl leaves the post of commanding officer.
Åke Rehnberg becomes commanding officer.
Åke Rehnberg leaves the post of commanding officer.
Bengt Bellander becomes commanding officer.
Bengt Bellander leaves the post of commanding officer.
Åke Lönnberg becomes commanding officer.
Åke Lönnberg leaves the post of commanding officer.
Per Widmark becomes commanding officer.

events.label: meteorology school
events.text: Air Force school of meteorology begins to be located at Ljungbyhed

evidence.quote: Between 1983 and 1996 the Air Force school of meteorology was also located at Ljungbyhed

events.label: march
events.text: School march Krigsflygskolans marsch adopted and established.

evidence.quote: The march was adopted and established on 20 August 1984

events.text: Per Widmark leaves the post of commanding officer.
Sven Sjöling becomes commanding officer.

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: First coat of arms ceases to be used.

evidence.quote: The units first coat of arms was used until 1994

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Second coat of arms begins to be used.

evidence.quote: Its second coat of arms was used from 1994 to 1998

events.label: decommissioning
events.text: F 5 Ljungbyhed decommissioned; pilot training taken over by F 10.

events.label: meteorology school
events.text: Air Force school of meteorology ceases to be located at Ljungbyhed

evidence.quote: Between 1983 and 1996 the Air Force school of meteorology was also located at Ljungbyhed

events.label: colour
events.text: Second school colour presented at F 5 Ljungbyhed by King Carl XVI Gustaf.

evidence.quote: The units second colour was presented at F 5 Ljungbyhed on 25 August 1996

events.text: Sven Sjöling leaves the post of commanding officer.

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Second coat of arms use period ends.

evidence.quote: Its second coat of arms was used from 1994 to 1998

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Second coat of arms begins use by the school at F 10.

evidence.quote: by the Flying School at F 10 from 1998 to 2002

events.text: School colour begins use at Scania Air Force Wing (F 10).

evidence.quote: The colour was used as school colour at the Scania Air Force Wing ( F 10 ) from 1 July 1998

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Coat of arms use at F 10 ends.

evidence.quote: by the Flying School at F 10 from 1998 to 2002

evidence.quote: by the Flying School at F 16 from 2002 to 2003

events.label: colour
events.text: School colour use at Scania Air Force Wing (F 10) ends.

events.text: Coat of arms use at F 16 ends.

evidence.quote: by the Flying School at F 16 from 2002 to 2003
